contract: Pure stall verdict over 1..256 recorded v1 pattern-step entries of one Run: repeated identical actions at the caller's count, then no non-wake input within the caller's idle bound unless an open ask or host-listed approval wait is in the window; stops nothing.
limits: Sees only the window: an open ask or approval wait whose request is outside it is not recognised; the caller sizes the window.
Thresholds are per-call operands with no default; no clock, timer, process, storage, new input kind or Run-ended rule.
Retry exhaustion belongs to delivery/retry-timeout; the verdict is about the record, not a provider, person or retry policy.

grounding.claim: Named repeated_identical_actions, no_new_input_within_bound, healthy_person_or_approval_wait, window_over_bound_refused, deterministic_verdict and checked-example scenarios pass on fixed recorded traces; finite tests, not a proof.
Pinned Elixir exact term equality and integer arithmetic; ready PatternStep decode/open/accept validation and settlement are reused unchanged.

The host passes the window in true record order with engine-recorded times, Run-wide unique action IDs, a truthful approval_waits list, and a window that holds the request of each open ask and approval wait.

telemetry.contract: Pure verdict emits no observations; the caller owns instrumentation.

config.contract: The two thresholds are per-call operands and the 256 bound is fixed; no ambient settings.

control.contract: No process or lifecycle; the caller decides what to do with a verdict.
